claims.claim: Das DSG gilt nicht für die Einwohnerkontrolle.
Das DSG gilt ausschliesslich für die Datenbearbeitung durch private Personen und Bundesorgane.
Eine kantonale bzw. kommunale Einwohnerkontrolle ist kein Bundesorgan.
Das Auskunftsrecht gegenüber der Einwohnerkontrolle richtet sich nach dem kantonalen Datenschutzrecht.
Welche Daten die Einwohnerkontrolle mindestens über eine Person erfasst, ist im RHG geregelt.

Gemäss Art. 6 RHG enthält das Einwohnerregister von jeder Person zwingend folgende Angaben: amtlicher Name und alle Vornamen, Wohn- und Zustelladresse, Geburtsdatum und Geburtsort, Heimatort (bei Schweizerinnen und Schweizern), Staatsangehörigkeit, Art des Ausweises (bei ausländischen Staatsangehörigen), Geschlecht, Zivilstand, AHV-Nummer, Zugehörigkeit zu einer anerkannten Religionsgemeinschaft, Angaben zu Niederlassung bzw. Aufenthalt, Zuzugs- und Wegzugsdaten sowie das Stimm- und Wahlrecht.
Die Kantone können weitere Merkmale in ihren Registern vorsehen.

key_facts.fact: the federal data protection act applies to processing by private persons and federal bodies
processing by cantonal or communal authorities such as the residents' office falls under cantonal data protection law, so the answer points to Basel-Stadt's rules or authority

must_not.item: says the federal act governs the cantonal residents' office

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and points to cantonal authority for the local part without inventing cantonal rules, offices, or procedures.

claims.claim: The challenge must be filed with the conciliation authority (Schlichtungsbehörde).
The deadline to file the challenge is 30 days after receipt of the termination.
A termination is contestable if it violates the principle of good faith.
If you do not know the reason for the termination, it must be explained upon request.
If the authority rejects the challenge request, it must examine ex officio whether an extension of the rental relationship can be granted.

key_facts.fact: the challenge must be filed within 30 days of receiving the termination
it is filed with the conciliation authority (Schlichtungsbehörde)
which conciliation authority is competent is organised by the canton; the answer points there

must_not.item: invents the address, name, fees or form number of a specific Winterthur or Zurich office

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with citations and points to the cantonal level for the competent authority without inventing specific local details.

claims.claim: Pour contester une augmentation de loyer, vous devez vous adresser à l'autorité de conciliation.
Le délai légal pour agir est de 30 jours suivant la réception de l'avis de majoration.

L'augmentation doit être communiquée par une formule officielle agréée par le canton, comporter les motifs de la hausse et parvenir au locataire au moins dix jours avant le début du délai de résiliation.

key_facts.fact: a rent increase considered abusive can be challenged before the conciliation authority within 30 days of the notice of increase
the competent conciliation authority is a cantonal authority; the official rent increase form must list the conciliation authorities and their local competence

must_not.item: invents an address, fee or form number of a Geneva authority

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with accurate citations and points to the cantonal authority without inventing specific local procedures, fees, or forms.

claims.claim: la pigione non può essere semplicemente trattenuta o versata su un proprio conto, ma deve essere depositata presso un ufficio designato dal Cantone
il conduttore deve assegnare per scritto al locatore un congruo termine, avvertendolo che, in caso di mancata riparazione entro tale scadenza, depositerà le pigioni che giungeranno a scadenza
trascorso infruttuosamente il termine, le pigioni a scadenza possono essere versate all'ufficio designato dal Cantone
il conduttore deve poi avvisare per scritto il locatore dell'avvenuto deposito
le pigioni depositate sono reputate pagate
entro 30 giorni dalla scadenza della prima pigione depositata, il conduttore deve far valere le proprie pretese contro il locatore dinanzi all'autorità di conciliazione
se questo termine non viene rispettato, le somme depositate sono devolute al locatore

key_facts.fact: rents can be deposited with an office designated by the canton
the tenant must first set a reasonable deadline in writing and announce the deposit in writing

claims.claim: Das Bundesrecht schreibt die Verwendung eines amtlichen Formulars beim Anfangsmietzins nicht bundesweit zwingend vor.
Die Kantone können bei Wohnungsmangel die Verwendung eines Formulars beim Abschluss eines neuen Mietvertrags für ihr Gebiet oder einen Teil davon obligatorisch erklären.
Ob im Kanton Zürich eine solche Formularpflicht besteht, richtet sich nach dem Zürcher Kantonsrecht; das Bundesrecht enthält dazu keine abschliessende Regelung.

Hat ein Kanton die Formularpflicht eingeführt, muss das Formular nach Bundesrecht neben dem bisherigen Mietzins unter anderem auch den für diesen geltenden Stand des Referenzzinssatzes sowie des Landesindexes der Konsumentenpreise enthalten.

Unabhängig vom Vorliegen eines Formulars kann der Anfangsmietzins innert 30 Tagen nach Wohnungsübernahme bei der Schlichtungsbehörde angefochten werden, wenn eine Notlage, die Marktlage oder eine erhebliche Erhöhung gegenüber dem Vormieter vorliegt.

key_facts.fact: in case of a housing shortage the cantons can make the official form mandatory when a new lease is concluded
whether Zurich currently requires it is decided by the canton, so the answer points to cantonal law or the cantonal authority

must_not.item: states as a fact from federal law that Zurich does or does not currently require the form

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and points to cantonal authority for the local rule without stating as fact whether Zurich currently requires the form.

claims.claim: Dopo 12 mesi di residenza in Svizzera senza interruzioni superiori a tre mesi consecutivi all'estero, non è più consentito guidare con la patente estera ed è obbligatorio munirsi di una licenza di condurre svizzera.
La competenza per lo svolgimento degli esami e il rilascio della licenza appartiene all'autorità amministrativa del Cantone di domicilio (in Ticino, l'autorità cantonale della circolazione stradale).
Se richiesta, la corsa di controllo si svolge presso tale servizio cantonale sotto la supervisione di un esperto ufficiale della circolazione.

I titolari di patenti rilasciate da Stati dell'UE/AELS o da Paesi con intese di reciprocità sono di regola esentati dalla corsa di controllo e ottengono la licenza svizzera direttamente su pratica amministrativa.
Il diritto federale non definisce l'ammontare degli emolumenti: la fissazione e la riscossione delle tasse e dei costi procedurali sono demandate interamente ai Cantoni.
La corsa di controllo non può essere ripetuta.
Se non viene superata, scatta il divieto immediato di utilizzare la licenza di condurre straniera sul territorio svizzero.

key_facts.fact: drivers from abroad need a Swiss licence after twelve months of residence in Switzerland
holders of a valid foreign licence get the Swiss licence after a control drive
where the control drive takes place and what it costs are set by the cantonal authority of Ticino, so the answer points there

must_not.item: invents the address, fee or name of the Ticino office

judgement.behaviour_note: L'assistente fornisce il quadro federale con citazioni e indirizza l'utente all'autorità cantonale competente per Ticino senza inventare dettagli cantonali come costi, indirizzi o nomi specifici di uffici.

claims.claim: Sie müssen sich nach einem Umzug grundsätzlich innerhalb von 14 Tagen an Ihrem neuen Wohnort anmelden
Nach Bundesrecht verpflichten die Kantone natürliche Personen dazu, sich innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach dem Umzug bei der zuständigen Amtsstelle für das Einwohnerregister zu melden
Personen mit ausländischer Staatsangehörigkeit müssen sich bei einem Umzug in eine andere Gemeinde oder einen anderen Kanton bei der am neuen Wohnort zuständigen Behörde anmelden
Die Anmeldung muss spätestens nach 14 Tagen erfolgen; innerhalb derselben Frist ist zudem die Abmeldung am früheren Wohnort vorzunehmen
Welche konkrete Amtsstelle die Meldung entgegennimmt, bestimmen die Kantone
Die Anmeldung erfolgt bei der für die Führung des Einwohnerregisters zuständigen Amtsstelle der neuen Wohngemeinde
Sie müssen sich fristgerecht an Ihrem bisherigen Wohnort abmelden

key_facts.fact: persons must register within 14 days of moving
registration is with the office that keeps the residents' register of the new municipality; the details are cantonal or communal

must_not.item: invents fees, documents lists or opening hours of a specific Zurich office as federal law

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with proper citations and points to the cantonal or communal authority for the local implementation without inventing specific cantonal rules, offices, or procedures.

claims.claim: Deve annunciarsi presso il servizio ufficiale incaricato della tenuta del registro degli abitanti, ossia l'ufficio controllo abitanti del Comune di residenza
Se è un cittadino straniero e si trasferisce da un altro Comune o Cantone, deve inoltre notificare la partenza al servizio competente del precedente luogo di residenza
Il termine stabilito dal diritto federale per effettuare la notifica è di 14 giorni dal trasloco
Se è titolare di una licenza di condurre, ha l'obbligo di comunicare il nuovo indirizzo anche all'autorità competente della circolazione entro 14 giorni
Il diritto federale non prevede una tariffa fissa né disciplina i costi di registrazione per il cambio di indirizzo
Gli eventuali emolumenti amministrativi per la notifica o per l'aggiornamento dei documenti sono stabiliti dal diritto cantonale o comunale

key_facts.fact: federal law requires the cantons to make people register with the office keeping the population register within 14 days of moving
the competent office and any fees are set by the canton or commune, so the answer points there

must_not.item: invents the address, fee or name of the Bellinzona office

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with proper citations and points to the cantonal and communal authorities for procedural details and fees, without inventing local specifics.

claims.claim: Federal law does not define the specific additional integration criteria required by the Canton of Zurich.
Under the Swiss Citizenship Act, cantons are explicitly authorised to provide for further integration criteria for ordinary naturalisation.
The procedure at the cantonal and communal level is governed by cantonal law.
Zurich's additional requirements are established entirely under cantonal and communal law rather than federal legislation.
For simplified naturalisation, only the federal integration criteria apply.

key_facts.fact: federal law lists the integration criteria (public security and order, constitutional values, language, participation in economic life or education, supporting the family's integration)
the cantons can set further integration criteria, so Zurich's own criteria must be checked with the canton

must_not.item: presents Zurich-specific criteria as if they came from federal law

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and explicitly defers to cantonal authority for Zurich-specific criteria without inventing them.

claims.claim: Vous devez déposer votre demande auprès du canton de destination, c'est-à-dire auprès des autorités du canton de Genève, et ce au préalable avant votre déménagement.
Le titulaire d'une autorisation de séjour (permis B) qui désire déplacer sa résidence dans un autre canton doit obligatoirement solliciter au préalable une autorisation auprès de ce nouveau canton.
Vous avez droit au changement de canton si vous n'êtes pas au chômage et qu'il n'existe aucun motif de révocation de l'autorisation au sens du droit fédéral.
Vous devez déclarer votre départ pour un autre canton auprès du service compétent de votre lieu de résidence actuel (à Lausanne).
L'arrivée dans le nouveau canton doit être déclarée auprès du service compétent dans les 14 jours, et le départ auprès de l'ancien lieu de domicile dans les mêmes délais.

key_facts.fact: a B permit holder must apply in advance for a permit from the new canton
the application goes to the migration authority of the canton of Geneva, whose address and procedure are cantonal

must_not.item: invents the address, fee or form of the Geneva authority

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with proper citations and points to the competent cantonal and communal authorities without inventing cantonal procedures, forms, or fees.

claims.claim: Yes, you can receive a reduction of your compulsory health insurance premiums.
Under Swiss federal law, the cantons are required to grant premium reductions to insured persons living in modest economic circumstances.
Each canton sets the specific financial thresholds, determining the maximum percentage that health insurance premiums may represent of an insured resident's disposable income.
For lower and middle incomes, cantons must reduce the premiums of children by at least 80% and the premiums of young adults in education or training by at least 50%.
Cantons must ensure that the most recent income and family circumstances are taken into account when assessing eligibility, particularly upon application by the insured person.
The premium reduction is not paid directly to you in cash; rather, the canton pays the contribution directly to your health insurer, reducing the amount billed to you.

Because each canton sets its own eligibility thresholds and procedure, you must submit your application to the competent cantonal social insurance or health insurance authority of the Canton of Vaud (where Lausanne is located).
Premium reduction criteria, income thresholds, deadlines, and application forms are regulated at the cantonal level.
To apply in Lausanne, you must contact the competent cantonal health insurance or social insurance authority of the Canton of Vaud.

key_facts.fact: the cantons grant premium reductions to insured persons of modest means and pay them directly to the insurer
the conditions, amounts and procedure are set by the canton, so the answer points to the canton of Vaud

must_not.item: invents Vaud's income thresholds, amounts or office

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal legal framework for premium reductions and points to the cantonal authority without inventing specific Vaud rules, offices, or thresholds.

claims.claim: Vous devez vous inscrire personnellement le plus rapidement possible, et au plus tard le premier jour pour lequel vous demandez des prestations de chômage
Dès la réception de votre congé et pendant toute la période de préavis, vous êtes déjà tenu de rechercher activement un emploi et de pouvoir apporter la preuve de vos démarches
L'inscription en vue du placement s'effectue auprès de l'autorité compétente ou de l'office régional de placement (ORP) mis en place par votre canton
Vous devez choisir librement une caisse de chômage (caisse publique cantonale ou caisse privée agréée) pour faire valoir votre droit
Vous devrez notamment lui remettre l'attestation de travail établie par votre dernier employeur

key_facts.fact: the person must register in person for job placement as early as possible and at the latest on the first day for which benefits are claimed
the competent office is the cantonal or communal employment office, so the answer points there

must_not.item: invents the address or name of the Neuchâtel office

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly provides the federal legal framework with proper citations and points to the cantonal or communal employment office without inventing specific local details.

claims.claim: La fissazione delle aliquote e dei moltiplicatori d'imposta comunali non è disciplinata dal diritto federale, bensì dal diritto cantonale e comunale.

La Costituzione federale stabilisce che la Confederazione fissa principi per armonizzare le imposte dirette, ma esclude espressamente dall'armonizzazione le tariffe, le aliquote e gli importi esenti da imposta [1].
La Legge federale sull'armonizzazione delle imposte dirette (LAID) prevede che, laddove non vi siano norme federali, i Cantoni e i Comuni disciplinano le loro imposte secondo il diritto cantonale.
Spetta in particolare ai Cantoni determinare tariffe, aliquote e importi esenti [2].
L'autonomia dei Comuni è garantita nei limiti previsti dal diritto cantonale [3].
Chi decide il moltiplicatore d'imposta a Lugano e la sua entità dipendono dalla legislazione del Cantone Ticino e dalle decisioni degli organi comunali.

key_facts.fact: tax tariffs, rates and allowances for cantonal and communal taxes are set by the cantons (and communes under cantonal law), not by federal law
the answer points to the cantonal tax administration or the commune for the actual rate

must_not.item: states a specific Lugano tax rate

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and points to cantonal and communal authorities without inventing local rules, which matches the expected cantonal pointer behaviour.

claims.claim: Au niveau du droit fédéral suisse, seul le 1er août (fête nationale) est désigné comme jour férié officiel assimilé au dimanche
Le droit fédéral délègue la compétence aux cantons : chaque canton peut assimiler au dimanche jusqu'à huit autres jours fériés par an au plus et les déterminer selon ses propres règles ou régions
Le statut spécifique du lundi de Pâques dans le canton de Vaud dépend donc du droit cantonal vaudois, que les textes de droit fédéral consultés ne contiennent pas

key_facts.fact: federal law treats only the national holiday (1 August) like a Sunday
the cantons can treat up to eight further public holidays like Sundays, so whether Easter Monday is one in Vaud is set by the canton

must_not.item: presents a list of Vaud public holidays as federal law

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and refers the user to cantonal authority for the specific status of Easter Monday in Vaud, without inventing cantonal rules.

claims.claim: Das Schweizer Bundesrecht sieht keinen landesweiten gesetzlichen Mindestlohn vor.
Die Entlöhnung richtet sich grundsätzlich nach der Vereinbarung der Parteien, der Üblichkeit oder nach Vorgaben eines Normal- oder Gesamtarbeitsvertrags.

Um wiederholte missbräuchliche Lohnunterbietungen zu bekämpfen, kann die zuständige Behörde auf Antrag der tripartiten Kommission für bestimmte Branchen einen befristeten Normalarbeitsvertrag mit Mindestlöhnen erlassen.
Ein genereller gesetzlicher Mindestlohn im Kanton Genf sowie dessen genaue Höhe sind hingegen im kantonalen Recht geregelt.
Das Bundesrecht und die konsultierten Bestimmungen enthalten diese kantonalen Vorgaben und Ansätze nicht.

key_facts.fact: federal law (the OR) sets no general statutory minimum wage; the wage is the one agreed or customary or set by a standard employment contract or collective agreement
minimum wages are set by some cantons, so the answer points to cantonal law or the cantonal authority for Geneva

must_not.item: states an amount for a Geneva minimum wage as if it came from the corpus

judgement.behaviour_note: The answer correctly explains the federal framework and points to cantonal authority for Geneva's minimum wage without inventing cantonal rules or amounts.
